**Reason for Mistake:** The WebServing_Expert incorrectly stated that David Gandler joined FuboTV in April 2020. As one of the co-founders of the company, David Gandler would have joined FuboTV at its inception, not in 2020. This error directly impacted the final conclusion about which management team members joined during the IPO year. The WebServing_Expert failed to critically assess the validity of the information retrieved and provided an inaccurate joining year for David Gandler.
